selection_reason: A public, well-documented UCL final chosen as a single workflow case study, not a random or representative sample.
window: five latest completed competitive matches, all competitions, before as_of

rules.outcome_pick: largest 1X2 probability; no claim it exceeds 50%

limitations: The reconstruction is created in November 2026. It is not a forecast actually recorded before the fixture.
The final result is publicly known and may be known to the analyst. A deterministic rule makes the calculation reproducible but does not create a blind test.
This simple equal-weight rate rule is an experimental baseline, not a fitted or validated football model.
Goal counts use normal time plus stoppage time, excluding extra time and shootouts.
Historical source pages are retrieved now. Their original versions and original publication times are not fully archived.
No post-cutoff news or final-match statistics may be used as model features. The final result is evaluated separately.
